comment: Phase 4 cycling Reel idea bank. Categories mirror what the account audit says wins: listicle tips (top saves), relatable identity humor (top engagement), advocacy (top reach/shares), Black cycling history (proven with Major Taylor). Add ideas freely; cycling-topics.mjs tracks usage in cycling-topics-used.json (gitignored) so nothing repeats until the bank cycles.
